BearerAuth.description: Telnyx API key supplied as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. In production, auth may be validated by the API gateway and forwarded via Telnyx auth headers.

Payment.description: Machine Payment Protocol credential used on paid retries, sent as `Authorization: Payment ...`. Obtained by paying a challenge returned in the `WWW-Authenticate` header of a 402 response. This is not a Telnyx API key; initial challenge requests use standard bearer authentication instead.
Payment.name: Authorization

info.description: SIP trunking, SMS, MMS, Call Control and Telephony Data Services.
info.title: Telnyx API

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all mission definitions in your organization. Missions describe a goal and the tools, knowledge bases, and MCP servers agents may use to accomplish it.

post.description: Creates a new mission definition from the provided configuration and returns the created mission. Execute the mission by starting runs against it.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of recent events across every mission in your organization, optionally filtered by event type. Useful for building activity feeds or monitoring dashboards.

Returns a paginated list of recent runs across every mission in your organization, optionally filtered by run status. Useful for monitoring overall mission activity without querying each mission individually.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the specified mission definition and returns no content on success.

get.description: Get a mission by ID (includes tools, knowledge_bases, mcp_servers)

put.description: Replaces the specified mission's definition with the provided configuration and returns the updated mission.

post.description: Creates a copy of the specified mission as a new mission definition, so you can iterate on its configuration without modifying the original.

get.description: Returns the knowledge bases attached to the specified mission. Knowledge bases provide reference content agents can draw on during runs.

post.description: Create a new knowledge base for a mission

delete.description: Detaches the specified knowledge base from the mission so its content is no longer available to agents in subsequent runs.

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge base.
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

get.description: Returns the details of a single knowledge base attached to the specified mission.

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge base.
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

put.description: Replaces the definition of the specified knowledge base on this mission.

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge base.
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

get.description: Returns the MCP servers configured on the specified mission. MCP servers expose external tools and data sources agents can use during runs.

post.description: Adds an MCP server to the specified mission, making the server's tools available to agents during runs of this mission.

delete.description: Removes the specified MCP server from the mission, revoking agent access to its tools in subsequent runs.

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the mcp server.
parameters.name: mcp_server_id

get.description: Returns the configuration of a single MCP server attached to the specified mission.

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the mcp server.
parameters.name: mcp_server_id

put.description: Replaces the configuration of the specified MCP server on this mission.

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the mcp server.
parameters.name: mcp_server_id

get.description: Returns a paginated list of runs for the specified mission, optionally filtered by run status, so you can track the mission's execution history over time.

post.description: Starts a new run of the specified mission and returns the created run object. Track its progress through the run detail, plan, and events endpoints.

get.description: Returns the full details of a single run, including its current status. Use this to poll an in-flight run or inspect the outcome of a completed one.

patch.description: Updates a run's status and/or result and returns the updated run object. Typically used by executing agents to report progress or record the final outcome.

post.description: Cancels a running or paused run and returns the updated run object. A cancelled run stops executing; start a new run to execute the mission again.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of events logged for the specified run, filterable by event type, plan step, and agent, so you can reconstruct exactly what happened during execution.

post.description: Logs a new event against the specified run and returns the created event. Events form the run's audit trail and can reference a plan step or agent.

get.description: Returns the details of a single event logged for the specified run, including its type and payload.

post.description: Pauses a currently running run and returns the updated run object. Execution halts until the run is resumed.

get.description: Returns the plan for the specified run, including all plan steps and their statuses, so you can see how the mission was decomposed and how far execution has progressed.

post.description: Creates the initial plan for the specified run from the provided steps and returns the created plan steps. Progress is subsequently reported by updating individual steps.
Add one or more steps to an existing plan

get.description: Returns the details of a single plan step within a run's plan, including its status.

patch.description: Updates the status of a single plan step and returns the updated step. Typically called by the executing agent as it works through the plan.

post.description: Resumes a previously paused run and returns the updated run object, letting execution continue from where it was paused.

get.description: Returns the Telnyx agents currently linked to the specified run. Linked agents participate in executing the run's plan.

post.description: Link a Telnyx AI agent (voice/messaging) to a run

delete.description: Unlinks the specified Telnyx agent from the run so it no longer participates in execution. The run itself and its history are unaffected.

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the telnyx agent.
parameters.name: telnyx_agent_id

get.description: Returns the tools configured on the specified mission. Tools define the actions agents may invoke while executing the mission's runs.

post.description: Adds a new tool to the specified mission, defining an action agents can invoke during runs of this mission.

delete.description: Removes the specified tool from the mission so agents can no longer invoke it in subsequent runs.

get.description: Returns the definition of a single tool configured on the specified mission.

put.description: Replaces the definition of the specified tool on this mission.
